decisions.reason: The source's two main-to-sensor interboard connectors are already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The SPS30 SEL-to-GND mode selection is already established by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE; the remaining source details concern its physical connector interface.
The source confirms a 5V pin for the SPS30 connector but does not change the existing switched-rail loads, control, voltage, or shutdown behavior.
The sensor connector inventory does not change which rails are monitored, their coverage, monitor placement, or channel allocation.
The connector pinouts do not change the standalone regulator, its capacity, source-selection topology, activation condition, or intended debugging load.
The JST-PH connector in the source is the sensor board's power input, not the separate battery connector, so the overlap is incidental.
The source mentions an I2C display connector but does not change the separate eight-SK6812 LED board.
The sensor board connector inventory does not alter the AXP2101 battery/USB topology or normal-operation power source.
Specifying connector families and cable matches does not itself change the existing sourceability policy or establish a new availability decision.
The source assigns I2C signals to connectors and ports but does not change bus speed, cable length, pull-ups, or series-resistor conditioning.
The source defines sensor-board interfaces and does not change the ESP32 module model or establish a different MCU breakout requirement.
Message 371 does not discuss the addressable LEDs, their supply voltage, or their level-shifter requirement.
